anvil:aws:KinesisStream.description: An Anvil-managed Kinesis Data Stream. On-demand capacity by default (set provisioned for a fixed shard count), and server-side encryption with the AWS-managed KMS key (alias/aws/kinesis) is always on. Wire consumers yourself; use grantRead/grantWrite to give compute access.

maxRecordSizeKib.description: Largest record the stream accepts, in KiB, 1024–10240. Default: 2048, so the stream can take Aurora DSQL CDC events (rows up to 2 MiB) without extra config.

provisioned.description: Switches the stream from on-demand to provisioned capacity with a fixed shard count. When omitted, the stream is on-demand and scales shards automatically with traffic — the right choice unless throughput is steady and predictable.

retentionHours.description: How long records stay readable, in hours, 24–8760 (365 days). Default: 24. Retention beyond 24 hours is billed separately.

arn.description: The ARN of the Kinesis stream.

name.description: The physical name of the Kinesis stream.

arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) specifying the Stream (same as `id`)

encryptionType.description: The encryption type to use. The only acceptable values are `NONE` or `KMS`. The default value is `NONE`.

enforceConsumerDeletion.description: A boolean that indicates all registered consumers should be deregistered from the stream so that the stream can be destroyed without error. The default value is `false`.

kmsKeyId.description: The GUID for the customer-managed KMS key to use for encryption. You can also use a Kinesis-owned master key by specifying the alias `alias/aws/kinesis`.

maxRecordSizeInKib.description: The maximum size for a single data record in KiB. The minimum value is 1024. The maximum value is 10240.

name.description: A name to identify the stream. This is unique to the AWS account and region the Stream is created in.

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.

retentionPeriod.description: Length of time data records are accessible after they are added to the stream. The maximum value of a stream's retention period is 8760 hours. Minimum value is 24. Default is 24.

shardCount.description: The number of shards that the stream will use. If the `stream_mode` is `PROVISIONED`, this field is required. Amazon has guidelines for specifying the Stream size that should be referenced when creating a Kinesis stream. See [Amazon Kinesis Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/dev/amazon-kinesis-streams.html) for more.

shardLevelMetrics.description: A list of shard-level CloudWatch metrics which can be enabled for the stream. See [Monitoring with CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/monitoring-with-cloudwatch.html) for more. Note that the value ALL should not be used; instead you should provide an explicit list of metrics you wish to enable.

streamModeDetails.description: Indicates the [capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/how-do-i-size-a-stream.html) of the data stream. Detailed below.

tags.description: A map of tags to assign to the resource. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

shardCount.description: Number of shards. Each shard takes 1 MB/s or 1,000 records/s in and serves 2 MB/s out. Default: 1.
